title: Airframe & Structure
summary: A lightweight frame, built for speed.
details: A rigid, lightweight frame that keeps the camera view clear and carries the sensors and electronics the mission needs.

title: Propulsion & Power
details: Motors, propellers, and batteries balanced for a fast dash to the scene and enough time on station to be useful.

title: Flight Control & Failsafes
summary: Agile when flown. Stable when observing.
details: Flight control that supports agile manual FPV flight, stable hovering over a scene, and automatic return home if the link or battery runs low.

title: FPV Video & Sensing
summary: See the scene, through smoke and at night.
details: Low-latency live video for the pilot, paired with thermal imaging to find people and hotspots in smoke and darkness.

title: Onboard Compute & Autonomy
details: Onboard FPGA processing that highlights people, vehicles, and hotspots in the live view and marks their locations for incident command.

title: Communications & Compliance
details: Reliable radio links for control, video, and telemetry, with flight operations planned to follow FAA rules.

title: Simulation & Validation
details: A simulation-first process: model and test the vehicle in software, then move to bench tests, controlled flight, and field scenarios.
